query:
UPDATE modules
            SET icon = 'lightbulb',
                ui_config = jsonb_set(
                    COALESCE(ui_config, '{}'),
                    '{sidebar,icon}',
                    '"lightbulb"'
                )
            WHERE module_key = 'brainstorming'
              AND tenant_id = $1
              AND icon = 'pen-tool'
